notes.title: UPDATE: new update is progressing but taking a min...
notes.notes:
Hey guys hope you are having an awesome weekend, two weeks have went by and im still working on the next update its rather big in comparison to the other updates im trying to get alot of things out the gate:

Updating character movement (some animations are a bit hideous lol)
Overhauling the combat mechanics for the player
Opening up new areas (survivor areas, boss areas etc)
Adding UI enhancements (tutorial UI at beginning, better UI animations etc)
Inserting "magic" for player and how that fits the overall story
Add more interactive NPC's (roaming, dying, dialogue etc)


and those are just the major ones so definitely a big update! I probably wont get all these in the next update but these are the main focus before jumping into AI overall and opening the rest of the areas for the game...after that is will just be fixes and touch ups + bug fixes that come along with the updates and soon a full release!! dont forget to join the discord(like on the main page) if you are experiencing any problem what so ever!

You guy enjoy the rest of your Sunday!.

notes.title: Missed an update cycle, Next update this Friday
notes.notes:
Hey guys! sorry i missed this fridays update, had some computer problems and couldnt ipen up my game map, and I have been focused on making sure things like the save system works as I am gearing up for ID@Xbox submission.

This current update, the things im focusing on:


 A save system and save points for the game as it is currently.
 A new Boss-like area ( this is a W.I.P. but should convey what it needs to)
 More NPC's they are important for story and context so always talk to them when you can!.
 A new Cave progressing one of the main objectives!.



There might be some miscellaneous fixes and addition in there, and of course im always improving and tweaking combat and AI..
well hope you guys had a great weekend and will catch you guys later!.
